name: Session Bridge
description: Cross-channel session context bridging via /session command. List, name, and load session context across channels using Gemini, OpenAI, or OpenRouter for summarization.

provider.description: LLM provider for naming and summarization (default: gemini)

geminiApiKey.description: Gemini API key (or GEMINI_API_KEY env / macOS Keychain service 'gemini', account 'api-key')

openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key (or OPENAI_API_KEY env / macOS Keychain service 'openai', account 'api-key')

openrouterApiKey.description: OpenRouter API key (or OPENROUTER_API_KEY env / macOS Keychain service 'openrouter', account 'api-key')

maxTranscriptChars.description: Maximum transcript characters to send to LLM for summarization

provider.label: LLM Provider
provider.help: Which LLM provider to use for session naming and summarization

openaiBaseUrl.label: OpenAI Base URL
openaiBaseUrl.help: Custom base URL for OpenAI-compatible APIs (e.g. local LLMs, Azure)

maxTranscriptChars.label: Max Transcript Size
maxTranscriptChars.help: Maximum characters of transcript to send to LLM
